!
ip access-list sec-1 permit ip src any dest any
ike proposal ike-prop-1 encryption aes-256 hash sha2-256 group 2048-bit lifetime 86400
ike policy ike-1 peer-fqdn-ipv4 rt-q09.example.com key dummy-psk-sample-name ike-prop-1
ipsec autokey-proposal ipsec-prop-1 esp-aes-256 esp-sha2-256 lifetime time 3600
ipsec autokey-map ipsec-1 sec-1 peer-fqdn-ipv4 rt-q09.example.com pfs off ipsec-prop-1
!
ip access-list sec-2 permit ip src any dest any
ike proposal ike-prop-2 encryption aes-256 hash sha2-256 group 2048-bit lifetime 86400
ike policy ike-2 peer 203.0.113.40 key dummy-psk-sample-c ike-prop-2
ipsec autokey-proposal ipsec-prop-2 esp-aes-256 esp-sha2-256 lifetime time 3600
ipsec autokey-map ipsec-2 sec-2 peer 203.0.113.40 pfs off ipsec-prop-2
!
ip access-list sec-0 permit ip src any dest any
ike proposal ike-prop-0 encryption aes-256 hash sha2-256 group 2048-bit lifetime 86400
ike policy ike-0 peer any key dummy-psk-sample-vt ike-prop-0

ipsec dynamic-map ipsec-0 sec-0 pfs off ike ike-0 ipsec-prop-0

ike nat-traversal

interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample-wan
  ip address 203.0.113.9/29
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample-lan
  ip address 192.0.2.1/25
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2.0
  description sample-lan-cust-a
  ip vrf forwarding cust-a
  ip address 192.0.2.129/25
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel0.0
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet1.0
  tunnel mode ipsec
  ipsec policy tunnel ipsec-0 out
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel1.0
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet1.0
  tunnel mode ipsec
  ipsec policy tunnel ipsec-1 out
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel2.0
  ip vrf forwarding cust-a
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet2.0
  tunnel mode ipsec
  ipsec policy tunnel ipsec-2 out
  no shutdown
!
